source: PX4 Flight Review public logs (https://review.px4.io), listed in the public database https://review.px4.io/dbinfo, downloaded 2026-10-20
licence: Public logs on PX4 Flight Review are uploaded with the option "Make this log publicly available under CC-BY PX4 license" (upload page, review.px4.io/upload). Attribution: the PX4 Flight Review uploaders of the log ids listed here.
selection: From the public database: multirotor (Quadrotor, Hexarotor, Octorotor), not SITL, 300 to 2400 s long, AUTO_MISSION over half the flight, no error labels; shuffled with seed 20261020, first 110 downloaded (files over 40 MB skipped). Kept: longest AUTO_MISSION segment at least 120 s with GPS fix 3D, battery remaining and local altitude. No thresholds were chosen with these flights.
fields: gps: t s, x east m, y north m relative to the first fix, 1 Hz from vehicle_gps_position; batteryUsedPct: battery_status.remaining start minus end over the segment; altVar: variance of altitude (-vehicle_local_position.z) over the segment in m2
